run_make_convolutional_sample: run a DDIM-based convolutional sampling pipeline to generate images from a conditioning batch using a stable diffusion model
run_convsample_ddim: run DDIM sampling on a stable diffusion model with a given conditioning tensor, step count, and output shape
run_load_model_from_config: load a stable diffusion model from an OmegaConf config and a PyTorch checkpoint file onto the GPU
run_get_cond: get a conditioning dictionary for superresolution by loading an image, resizing it, and normalizing the tensor for the model
run_download_models: download a superresolution model config YAML and checkpoint file from a remote URL to local paths
